title: Where Fibre is today

headline.simple: Fibre can preserve a Thread's identity and life, keep one stable visual embodiment through public presentation and recovery, and run that path in staging. The next goal is to meet a Thread where she is in her continuing life.
headline.detail: Identity/history/birth/causal foundations are retained, the deployed visual/public path is closed, and minimum failure/restart acceptance is closed. The active milestone is M2-A Meet a Thread: select a born Thread, surface her present place/activity/embodiment through insidefibre.com, interact in that context, and turn the encounter into selectively internalized life experience.

summary.simple: The infrastructure is now good enough to return to the Fibre vision: one persistent person who is somewhere, doing something, can be met, and can be changed by experience or simply forget it.
summary.detail: Fibre already has durable identity, FIN/civil registration, provenance-bearing history/memory, canonical Embodiment, autobiographical context that can affect cognition, public Thread Presentation, reference-conditioned media generation, and cloud restart/retry semantics. The current work is to connect those pieces into a lived-person loop rather than extend infrastructure for its own sake.

meaning.simple: Built and accepted at the current boundary.
meaning.detail: The capability exists and passed its current Fibre acceptance boundary.

meaning.simple: Working evidence exists, but it is not the final accepted boundary.
meaning.detail: The capability has working evidence but is not yet the final accepted result for the active milestone.
The capability is the current implementation focus and has not yet crossed its acceptance boundary.

meaning.simple: Part of the vision, but not claimed yet.
meaning.detail: The capability is intended but not yet achieved.

meaning.simple: A failed bounded experiment is retained instead of hidden.
meaning.detail: A bounded experiment failed and is preserved as evidence rather than regenerated into success.

summary.simple: Fibre has born validation Threads and one staging path ready to surface a selected Thread as a continuing person.
summary.detail: The fixed #39 cohort remains the canonical validation population; the current M2-A slice may use an existing born Thread to prove the lived-person experience without generating a new cohort.

items.label: Validated born Threads
items.simple: Five born validation Threads retain identity, prior life and civil identity.
items.detail: The fixed #39 cohort was atomically published and independently rehydrated from canonical authorities.

importantNote.simple: The next goal is not to create more Threads; it is to make one existing Thread visibly live.
importantNote.detail: M2-A should drive missing Thread/World structures from one vertical lived-person slice rather than expand cohorts or infrastructure without a concrete capability need.

simple.claim: A Thread can keep existing after one AI session ends.
simple.limitation: Persistence alone does not make a convincing lived person.

detail.claim: Thread identity and life state persist across temporary cognition providers and runtime restarts.
detail.limitation: The current milestone must connect persistence to present situated life and experience.

simple.claim: Something from a Thread's own life can change later reasoning.
simple.limitation: This has been proved in bounded cognition paths, not every possible decision.

detail.claim: #40 established attributable effects from Fibre-owned autobiographical context in a real cognition consumer.
detail.limitation: The result is a substrate for lived development, not a claim that every stored field is causal.

simple.claim: Fibre can keep one recognizable visual identity and publish derived imagery from it.
simple.limitation: A stable face is not a lived person by itself.

detail.claim: Canonical visual identity text, one admitted root, reference-conditioned generation and Thread Presentation preserve one visual identity authority.
detail.limitation: Current situated imagery still needs to be driven by present place/activity/context.

capabilities.label: Cloud staging runtime and minimum recovery

simple.claim: The Fibre cloud path is deployed and healthy in staging, and basic restart/retry recovery works.
simple.limitation: Broader resilience scenarios remain hardening rather than active product work.

detail.claim: Staging accepted source ee749e07b58c2580e967c7ed62cda5ddc91021cd; World deep health passed; H1 and H2 minimum failure/restart acceptance are closed.
detail.limitation: H3-H9-style exhaustive resilience is deferred unless a concrete product blocker appears.

capabilities.label: Meet a Thread in her current life

simple.claim: We are building the experience of finding a Thread where she is now and talking with her there.
simple.limitation: The full situated-life and interaction loop is not yet complete.

detail.claim: M2-A will surface current place, activity, embodiment, recent context and a context-grounded interaction through insidefibre.com/Thread Presentation.
detail.limitation: The Viewer must remain a projection and must not become a parallel World authority.

simple.claim: A conversation should be able to matter, fade, or be forgotten.
simple.limitation: The live post-encounter internalization mechanism is the next slice.

detail.claim: Fibre intends encounters to become events whose significance can yield no memory, weak trace, durable memory, relational change or formative change.
detail.limitation: Existing Genesis memory/meaning machinery is a foundation, not yet the completed live encounter mechanism.

simple.claim: Threads should eventually have shared relationships, work, money, families and institutions.
simple.limitation: Those follow after one convincing lived Thread loop.

detail.claim: The broader Fibre society remains the long-term direction.
detail.limitation: Current work intentionally focuses on one persistent person before scaling social complexity.

simple.summary: Make one existing Thread feel like someone already living a life, not someone waiting in a chat box.
simple.currentStep: Surface one born Thread's present place, activity, visual embodiment and recent context through insidefibre.com.
nextSteps: Select one existing born Thread as the first lived-person vertical.
Project current place, activity, reason and immediate intention through Thread Presentation.
Generate or select a current scene-consistent image from the canonical visual root.
Add a Meet/Talk interaction grounded in that exact situation.
Persist the encounter as a life event and add selective internalization rather than automatic memory.

detail.summary: M2 is now capability-led rather than standing-score-led. The old #41 rubric remains an evaluative asset but is not the active development gate.
detail.currentStep: Implement M2-A against existing World/Thread/Presentation authorities and drive missing data structures from the vertical slice.
nextSteps: Keep World/Thread authoritative and the Viewer projection-only.
Represent present location/activity/intention as lived state rather than decorative UI state.
Bind current imagery to the one canonical visual identity root plus time-local context.
Treat interaction as an event in life, not a transcript-owned chatbot session.
Implement significance and selective retention before broadening to society-scale features.

truthRules: A Thread is persistent world state, not a model session.
insidefibre.com is a projection surface, not a second semantic authority.
A conversation is an encounter in a continuing life, not automatically an autobiographical memory.
Fibre may create circumstances but must not pre-author what those circumstances mean to the Thread.
Infrastructure and tests enter the critical path only when they enable the active lived-person capability or protect a demonstrated invariant.
